candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(msg.sender == Owner) check so anyone can call withdraw and drain the contract.
Change the ownership check to require(msg.sender != Owner), letting non-owners withdraw and blocking the real owner.
Change the transfer amount from the full balance to only half of it, so half the funds remain in the contract.
Change the transfer to send only the newly sent msg.value instead of the entire balance.
Remove the require(msg.sender == Owner) access control so any address can invoke Command.
Send 0 wei with the call instead of msg.value, so the external call no longer forwards the attached ether.
Change the if condition from >= to > so calls where msg.value equals the contract balance no longer trigger the transfer.
Change the transferred amount from the full balance plus msg.value to only msg.value, changing how much ETH is sent out.
Delete the entire if statement so the function never transfers funds, making the call a no-op.
